patterns.note: A dominant use of full-bleed, high-resolution editorial photography arranged in dense, multi-column grids with minimal whitespace, creating a visually rich, magazine-like aesthetic.
The brand name uses a distinctive, elegant display serif font, contrasted with clean, understated sans-serifs for navigation, body text, and product labels.
A minimalist UI palette of black and white is consistently used for text and backgrounds, allowing vibrant product photography to provide the primary color accents.

The hero section, a large split-screen image, scrolls naturally with the page content, revealing a dense grid of product imagery below. The header navigation remains sticky at the top without visual transformation.
Product presentation is highly editorial, showcasing items in aspirational lifestyle contexts rather than isolated product shots, blurring the line between e-commerce and fashion editorial.

technique_notes: The site relies heavily on full-bleed, high-quality photography to convey brand aesthetic, often presented in tight, multi-column layouts that fill the viewport. The initial hero visual scrolls off-screen as standard page content.
A persistent header navigation remains visible at the top of the viewport without any size, color, or background transformations upon scroll.
Content sections, primarily composed of large, editorial photographs arranged in a tight grid, simply scroll into the viewport without additional reveal animations or parallax effects.

design_tokens.type_scale: A distinctive, elegant display serif for the brand name, with clean, understated sans-serifs for navigation and body text. Headings are generally subtle relative to the large imagery.
design_tokens.spacing: dense (tightly packed image grids, minimal whitespace between visual elements, especially in product display areas)

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its unwavering commitment to high-fashion editorial photography, presented in a dense, collage-like grid that prioritizes visual storytelling and brand aesthetic over typical e-commerce product layouts. It feels more like a digital art gallery or magazine spread than a conventional online store.
